```sql
SELECT 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN c."Continent" = 'Asia' THEN ch."population_resident" ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
   SUM(ch."population_resident")) * 100 AS asia_population_percentage
FROM main."country_history" ch
JOIN main."country" c ON ch."code" = c."Code"
WHERE ch."effective_month" = '2026-03';
```
